versions.yaml:
formId: system-provider-composition-v1
title: "Provider"
# Merges the 7 formerly-separate clinic-management forms (system-hospital-profile-v1,
# system-locations-profile-v1, system-staff-profile-v1, system-services-profile-v1,
# system-office-hours-profile-v1, system-consents-profile-v1, system-appointments-profile-v1)
# into one Organization-anchored composition — the clinic-management-side mirror of
# system-encounter-composition-v1.yaml's Patient-side merge. Organization MUST stay
# composition[0] — yaml-to-questionnaire.js derives subjectType only from
# composition[0].resourceType, same hard constraint as the Encounter file.
#
# Administrator is deliberately NOT its own block here — it stays a staff_role choice value
# (confirmed decision, not an oversight) since it has no fields distinct from Staff today.
#
# Hospital's own 3 ABDM sub-blocks (facility-type/location/registration) stay separate,
# non-repeating blocks rather than being collapsed into section_hospital — Hospital never
# repeats, so there's no correspondence-across-instances risk the way there would be for Staff
# (see below), and keeping them separate minimizes changes to the already-delicate ABDM
# registration field set.
#
# Staff's 3 former blocks (core/PractitionerRole/ABDM-registration) ARE collapsed into one
# section_staff block, repeats:true — collapsing is required here: if core/role/ABDM-
# registration stayed 3 independently-repeating sibling blocks, instance N of "core" would have
# no guaranteed correspondence to instance N of "role" for the same staff member once there's
# more than one. Each field keeps its original, accurate FHIR path even though they now share
# one block.
composition:
  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital
    label: "Hospital Details"
    fields:
      - id: "hospital_name"
        path: "Organization.name"
        label: "Hospital Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "hospital_legalname"
        path: "Organization.alias"
        label: "Legal / Trade Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_type"
        path: "Organization.type"
        label: "Facility Type"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Hospital","Clinic","Pharmacy","Laboratory","Imaging Centre"]
      - id: "hospital_npi"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "NPI / Registration No."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # SPEC-24 real gap found via a live pipeline run against ClinuxFlowFacility.json: this was
      # Organization.address.text (a free-text blob, real FHIR but not what the profile
      # constrains) — the profile requires Organization.address.line (1..2, matching HFR's own
      # addressLine1 Required + addressLine2 optional), which nothing here ever wrote to, so no
      # facility could validate no matter how completely this field was filled in. Retargeted;
      # .text was never a distinct field elsewhere, so this is a rename, not new data loss.
      - id: "hospital_address"
        path: "Organization.address.line"
        label: "Street Address"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_city"
        path: "Organization.address.city"
        label: "City"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_state"
        path: "Organization.address.state"
        label: "State"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_pin"
        path: "Organization.address.postalCode"
        label: "PIN Code"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_country"
        path: "Organization.address.country"
        label: "Country"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_phone"
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "Primary Phone"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_whatsapp"
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "WhatsApp Number"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_email"
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "Email Address"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_website"
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "Website URL"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  # UPDATE — real FHIR-native onboarding rebuild: ABDM's own field requirements (verified against
  # abdmAdapter.js's real gateway request bodies — every field referenced there, e.g.
  # buildHfrBasicInfoBody's ownershipCode/facilityType/facilitySubType/stateLGDCode/... — is
  # captured somewhere in this file already; "keep the ABDM fields as reference for minimal
  # completeness" confirmed no NEW fields were needed, just correct FHIR homes for them) are HFR
  # registry CODES, not general clinical/demographic data — none of them are a good semantic fit
  # for the generic paths they used before (Organization.type meant for a CodeableConcept
  # classification, Organization.identifier.value meant for a business identifier, not
  # registration-process metadata). "any field not found in the FHIR spec needed for ABDM capture
  # goes into extension fields" (explicit instruction) — moved to real, distinctly-URLed
  # Organization.extension entries instead. hospital_operational_status (Organization.active) and
  # hospital_facility_id/hospital_npi (Organization.identifier.value) are UNCHANGED — those ARE
  # already good, standard FHIR fits, not touched.
  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital_abdm_facility_type
    label: "Facility Type & Ownership"
    fields:
      - id: "hospital_ownership_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-ownership-code"
        label: "Ownership Code (HFR master: OWNER)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_facility_type"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-facility-type"
        label: "Facility Type Code (HFR master: facility-types)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_facility_subtype"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-facility-subtype"
        label: "Facility Sub-Type Code (HFR master: facility-sub-types)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # SPEC-24 real gap found while wiring conformance-validator.js against real captured data,
      # not while reading the YAML in isolation: ClinuxFlowFacility.json (data/structure-
      # definitions) requires ownershipSubTypeCode/systemOfMedicine/geoLatitude/geoLongitude
      # (min:1 each) — see New_HFR_APIs_Documentation_SBX.pdf's own get-owner-subtype and
      # facility-registration field tables — but no field on this form ever captured them; a
      # facility could never validate, full stop, no matter how completely both onboarding pages
      # were filled in. ownershipSubTypeCode is a master-data code exactly like ownershipCode
      # above it (real TextInput per HFR's own get-owner-subtype API, not a static local list).
      - id: "hospital_ownership_subtype_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-ownership-subtype-code"
        label: "Ownership Sub-Type Code (HFR master: get-owner-subtype)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # Real, standard AYUSH + Modern-Medicine/Dentistry categories, confirmed against
      # New_HFR_APIs_Documentation_SBX.pdf's own worked samples (systemOfMedicineCode "M,D" =
      # Modern Medicine + Dentistry, "UN,H" = Unani + Homeopathy) — HFR itself wants these as one
      # comma-joined code string on the wire, but ClinuxFlowFacility.json's own comment is explicit
      # that this profile models it as a real repeating extension, not a comma-joined string;
      # MultiSelect already writes one array slot per selection (same mechanism staff_specialty
      # above and hours_days below already use, and the one local-extractor.js MultiSelect bug —
      # answers truncated to the first choice — is already fixed).
      - id: "hospital_system_of_medicine"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-system-of-medicine"
        label: "System(s) of Medicine (HFR master: MEDICINE)"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["Modern Medicine (Allopathy)", "Ayurveda", "Homeopathy", "Unani", "Siddha", "Yoga & Naturopathy", "Dentistry"]
      # UPDATE — real bug found live via a full end-to-end pipeline test, not caught by reading
      # the YAML alone: this was `uiComponent: Dropdown` with 2 string choices, but
      # Organization.active is genuinely a FHIR boolean — the compiler maps Dropdown to a
      # `choice`-type item regardless of the target path, and nothing converts the string answer
      # "Functional"/"Non-Functional" into a real true/false, so extraction produced
      # `active: "Functional"` — structurally invalid for a real boolean field. staff_status
      # (Practitioner.active, right below in section_staff) already used Checkbox correctly; this
      # one didn't, inconsistently. Fixed at the authoring level, not by adding string->boolean
      # coercion to the extractor — a boolean concept should be captured as a real boolean.
      - id: "hospital_operational_status"
        path: "Organization.active"
        label: "Currently Operational"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      # SPEC-24 real gap found the same way as ownership-subtype/system-of-medicine/geo above:
      # HFR's own CODED operational-status value (get-master-data type='FAC-STATUS') is a real,
      # required, distinct field from Organization.active above — active is this profile's own
      # derived boolean for internal use (see ClinuxFlowFacility.json's own comment on this exact
      # distinction); this extension round-trips HFR's richer status code untouched. Never
      # captured before this.
      - id: "hospital_operational_status_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-operational-status-code"
        label: "Operational Status Code (HFR master: FAC-STATUS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital_abdm_location
    label: "ABDM Location (LGD Codes)"
    fields:
      # UPDATE — real bug this fix also closes: district_lgd_code and subdistrict_lgd_code both
      # mapped to the SAME Organization.address.district path before — with the real array-
      # cardinality fix (local-extractor.js's FHIR_ARRAY_PATHS), two fields sharing one leaf path
      # now correctly get separate array slots, which for Organization.address (itself an array)
      # would have split them into TWO DIFFERENT address entries instead of describing the SAME
      # one facility address — a real, different bug the extension move avoids entirely, not just
      # the "not really a FHIR-standard field" concern this section is otherwise about.
      - id: "hospital_state_lgd_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-state-lgd-code"
        label: "State LGD Code (HFR master: lgd/states)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_district_lgd_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-district-lgd-code"
        label: "District LGD Code (HFR master: lgd/districts)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_subdistrict_lgd_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-subdistrict-lgd-code"
        label: "Sub-District LGD Code (HFR master: lgd/subdistricts)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # SPEC-24: the other half of the same real gap noted above hospital_ownership_subtype_code
      # — ClinuxFlowFacility.json requires geoLatitude/geoLongitude (HFR: latitude/longitude,
      # Required, "-90.000000 to +90.000000"/"-180.000000 to +180.000000") but this form never
      # captured them. TextInput, not a number field — HFR's own docs specify these as strings.
      - id: "hospital_geo_latitude"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-geolocation-latitude"
        label: "Latitude"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_geo_longitude"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-geolocation-longitude"
        label: "Longitude"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital_abdm_registration
    label: "ABDM Facility Registration"
    fields:
      - id: "hospital_tracking_id"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-tracking-id"
        label: "Tracking ID (from Basic Information step)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # hospital_facility_id stays a real Organization.identifier — the ABDM-ASSIGNED facility id,
      # once registration completes, is a genuine business identifier for this Organization (same
      # reasoning hospital_npi already used), not registration-process metadata.
      - id: "hospital_facility_id"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "ABDM Facility ID (from Submit step)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_abdm_software_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-software-code"
        label: "ABDM-Compliant Software Code (get-Software-details master)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_source_of_information"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-source-of-information"
        label: "Source of Information"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_source_unique_id"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-source-unique-id"
        label: "Source Unique ID"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Location
    id: section_location
    label: "Branch / Location Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "location_name"
        path: "Location.name"
        label: "Branch Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "location_address"
        path: "Location.address.text"
        label: "Address"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "location_phone"
        path: "Location.telecom.value"
        label: "Phone"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Practitioner
    id: section_staff
    label: "Staff Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "staff_name"
        path: "Practitioner.name.text"
        label: "Full Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "staff_phone"
        path: "Practitioner.telecom.value"
        label: "Phone"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_email"
        path: "Practitioner.telecom.value"
        label: "Email"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_qualification"
        path: "Practitioner.qualification.code"
        label: "Qualification"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_license"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "License / Registration ID"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_status"
        path: "Practitioner.active"
        label: "Active"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      # UPDATE — real FHIR-native onboarding rebuild: staff_role/staff_specialty already used
      # Practitioner.extension (FHIR's own real escape hatch for this — correct call, kept), but
      # with NO `.url` — real FHIR extensions require one to say WHAT the extension is; multiple
      # untagged entries in one array are not reliably distinguishable. Every ABDM-specific field
      # below (previously piled onto the generic Practitioner.identifier.value, an 8-way collision
      # now array-safe per local-extractor.js's fix but still the wrong FHIR home) moves to its own
      # distinctly-URLed extension too — "any field not found in the FHIR spec needed for ABDM
      # capture goes into extension fields" (explicit instruction). staff_license/staff_hprid/
      # staff_hpr_id_number stay on Practitioner.identifier.value, UNCHANGED — those genuinely ARE
      # business identifiers for this Practitioner (a license number, an ABDM-assigned HPR ID),
      # not registration-process metadata.
      - id: "staff_role"
        path: "Practitioner.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/clinic-staff-role"
        label: "Role"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Chief of Medicine","Doctor","Nurse","Administrator","Receptionist","Radiologist"]
      - id: "staff_specialty"
        path: "Practitioner.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/clinic-staff-specialty"
        label: "Specialty"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["Cardiology","Neurology","Radiology","Pediatrics","Orthopedics","Dermatology","General Medicine","ENT","Ophthalmology","Psychiatry"]
      # ABDM's own fields, not this app's clinical vocabulary — staff_abdm_role (Doctor/Nurse/
      # Facility Manager) is deliberately separate from staff_role above (Chief of Medicine/.../
      # Administrator): the same person can hold a clinical role here and a different ABDM role
      # in HPR's own registry. staff_aadhaar/staff_otp/staff_hpr_password are intentionally NOT
      # fields on this form — see docs/onboarding/04-security-notes.md. They live only in the
      # onboarding page's transient state so there is no code path by which
      # SystemForms.saveDataRecord() could ever persist them.
      - id: "staff_first_name"
        path: "Practitioner.name.given"
        label: "First Name (as on Aadhaar)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_middle_name"
        path: "Practitioner.name.given"
        label: "Middle Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_last_name"
        path: "Practitioner.name.family"
        label: "Last Name (as on Aadhaar)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_hp_category_code"
        path: "Practitioner.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hpr-category-code"
        label: "HP Category Code (HPR master: system-of-medicine)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_hp_subcategory_code"
        path: "Practitioner.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hpr-subcategory-code"
        label: "HP Sub-Category Code"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_state_code"
        path: "Practitioner.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hpr-state-code"
        label: "State LGD Code (HPR master: states)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_district_code"
        path: "Practitioner.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hpr-district-code"
        label: "District LGD Code (HPR master: districts)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_council"
        path: "Practitioner.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinuxflow.example/fhir/StructureDefinition/hpr-registered-with-council"
        label: "Registered with a Medical/Nursing Council"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      - id: "staff_hprid"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "HPR ID (assigned after creation)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_hpr_id_number"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "HPR ID Number (assigned after creation)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  # SPEC-24 §2's own real modeling upgrade: PractitionerRole (this Practitioner's role AT this
  # facility) as a genuinely separate FHIR resource from Practitioner (the person), so one person
  # can later hold roles at more than one facility — the split ClinuxFlowProviderRole.json is
  # built against. A SIBLING top-level block, not nested inside section_staff above: nesting a
  # DIFFERENT resourceType's fields inside a repeating group compiles clean through
  # local-extractor.js (confirmed, and fixed a real cross-resourceType instance-clobbering bug
  # doing so) but NOT through yaml-to-questionnaire.js's own schema/dictionary validation, which
  # ties every field in a block — nested or not — to that ONE block's own declared resourceType;
  # a bare resource-type name like "PractitionerRole" is not a real field PATH within Practitioner
  # for that check to accept. Teaching the compiler a per-group resourceType override is a real,
  # separate piece of work, not bundled into this pass. A sibling block needs no compiler change
  # at all and is exactly the existing, already-proven pattern (section_hospital/section_staff/...
  # are already siblings, each its own resourceType) — the only real requirement it adds is that
  # the SAVE flow appends one section_staff instance and one section_staff_role instance together,
  # always in lockstep (hand-guaranteed by ProviderBasicsHost.vue's own merge logic, not LForms'
  # independent per-group "+ Add Another") — local-extractor.js's own separate-instances counter
  # is a simple running count per group linkId, so matching append order is what keeps the Nth
  # repetition of each block correctly correlated to the same real staff member.
  #
  # PractitionerRole.practitioner/.organization are NOT fields here — both get auto-linked by
  # local-extractor.js (matching this SAME repetition's own Practitioner, and the one Organization
  # in this record) once both resources exist in the same extraction — no manual reference field
  # needed, same as it already worked for the single-Practitioner case.
  - resourceType: PractitionerRole
    id: section_staff_role
    label: "Role at this Facility"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "staff_role_active"
        path: "PractitionerRole.active"
        label: "Currently Active in this Role"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      # Real HPR role codes confirmed against "1. Register Healthcare Professional (Doctor & Nurse)
      # API.pdf"'s own Roles table (1/2/3) — this WAS staff_abdm_role on Practitioner.extension
      # with invented Doctor/Nurse/Facility Manager choices, conflating the SEPARATE
      # hpCategoryCode concept above with the real HPR role table; ClinuxFlowProviderRole.json's
      # own comment already reconciles the prior YAML's "Administrator" concept as really being
      # HPR's own "Facility Manager" role. Retargeted here, not duplicated.
      - id: "staff_provider_role"
        path: "PractitionerRole.code"
        label: "HPR Role (HPR master: role)"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Healthcare Professional", "Facility Manager", "Healthcare Professional and Facility Manager"]

  - resourceType: HealthcareService
    id: section_services_matrix
    label: "Service Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "service_name"
        path: "HealthcareService.name"
        label: "Service Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "service_specialty_category"
        path: "HealthcareService.category"
        label: "Core Specialty Category"
        description: "The primary clinical vertical or domain classification such as Cardiology, Pediatrics, Optometry, or Lab Diagnostics."
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Cardiology", "Pediatrics", "Ophthalmology", "Optometry", "Diet & Wellness", "General Medicine"]
        required: true
      - id: "service_program_name"
        path: "HealthcareService.program"
        label: "Target Clinical Program Name"
        description: "The formal named program or specific diagnostic track offered, like Type 2 Diabetes Management or Periodontal Charting."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "service_description"
        path: "HealthcareService.comment"
        label: "Description"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Location
    id: section_hours
    label: "Operating Hours"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "hours_days"
        path: "Location.hoursOfOperation.daysOfWeek"
        label: "Days of Week"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["mon","tue","wed","thu","fri","sat","sun"]
      - id: "hours_open"
        path: "Location.hoursOfOperation.openingTime"
        label: "Opening Time"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hours_close"
        path: "Location.hoursOfOperation.closingTime"
        label: "Closing Time"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hours_allday"
        path: "Location.hoursOfOperation.allDay"
        label: "Open All Day"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"

  - resourceType: Consent
    id: section_consent
    label: "Consent Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "consent_title"
        path: "Consent.sourceAttachment.title"
        label: "Title"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "consent_category"
        path: "Consent.category"
        label: "Consent Type"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["HIPAA Privacy Notice","Informed Consent for Treatment","Financial Responsibility","Telemedicine Consent","Photography / Research","Minor Treatment Consent"]
        required: true
      - id: "consent_status"
        path: "Consent.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["draft","active","inactive","entered-in-error","rejected"]
      - id: "consent_datetime"
        path: "Consent.dateTime"
        label: "Date Signed"
        uiComponent: "DatePicker"
      - id: "consent_expiry"
        path: "Consent.provision.period.end"
        label: "Expiry Date"
        uiComponent: "DatePicker"

  - resourceType: Appointment
    id: section_appointment
    label: "Appointment Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "appt_patient"
        path: "Appointment.participant.actor"
        label: "Patient"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "appt_staff"
        path: "Appointment.participant.actor"
        label: "Staff Member"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "appt_status"
        path: "Appointment.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["proposed","booked","arrived","fulfilled","cancelled","noshow"]
        required: true
      - id: "appt_start"
        path: "Appointment.start"
        label: "Start Time"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "appt_end"
        path: "Appointment.end"
        label: "End Time"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "appt_description"
        path: "Appointment.description"
        label: "Reason / Notes"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

item.description: The primary clinical vertical or domain classification such as Cardiology, Pediatrics, Optometry, or Lab Diagnostics.
The formal named program or specific diagnostic track offered, like Type 2 Diabetes Management or Periodontal Charting.

versions.yaml:
formId: system-patient-profile-v1
title: "Patients"
composition:
  - resourceType: Patient
    id: section_patient

        path: "Patient.name.text"
        label: "Full Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "patient_gender"
        path: "Patient.gender"
        label: "Gender"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"

      - id: "patient_birthdate"
        path: "Patient.birthDate"
        label: "Date of Birth"

      - id: "patient_emergency_contact_name"
        path: "Patient.contact.name.text"
        label: "Emergency Contact Name"

formId: system-encounter-composition-v1
title: "Consultation"
# Merges the former system-encounter-intake-v1 / system-vitals-v1 / system-consultation-soap-v1 /
# system-prescription-v1 / system-billing-v1 into one Encounter-centered composition — one
# record per patient visit instead of five separately-keyed ones, loosely "linked" only by each
# copying the same encounter id into its own *_encounter_ref string field (never a real FHIR
# Reference). Encounter MUST stay composition block 0 — yaml-to-questionnaire.js derives
# subjectType only from composition[0].resourceType. UI-facing label is "Consultation"; the FHIR
# resourceType stays Encounter.
composition:
  - resourceType: Encounter
    id: section_encounter
    label: "Encounter Details"
    fields:
      - id: "encounter_patient_ref"
        path: "Encounter.subject"
        label: "Patient"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "encounter_chief_complaint"
        path: "Encounter.reasonCode"
        label: "Chief Complaint"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "encounter_status"
        path: "Encounter.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["arrived","in-progress","finished","cancelled"]
        required: true
      - id: "encounter_priority"
        path: "Encounter.priority"
        label: "Triage Priority"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Normal","Emergency"]

  - resourceType: Observation
    id: section_vitals
    label: "Vitals Capture"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "vitals_systolic"
        path: "Observation.component.valueQuantity.value"
        label: "Systolic BP"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "vitals_diastolic"
        path: "Observation.component.valueQuantity.value"
        label: "Diastolic BP"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "vitals_pulse"
        path: "Observation.component.valueQuantity.value"
        label: "Pulse (bpm)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "vitals_temperature"
        path: "Observation.component.valueQuantity.value"
        label: "Temperature (°F)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Condition
    id: section_soap
    label: "SOAP Note"
    fields:
      - id: "soap_subjective"
        path: "Condition.note.text"
        label: "Subjective"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        keywords: ["complains", "reports", "states", "feels", "patient says"]
      - id: "soap_objective"
        path: "Condition.note.text"
        label: "Objective"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        keywords: ["exam reveals", "vitals", "observed", "measured", "on examination"]
      - id: "soap_assessment"
        path: "Condition.note.text"
        label: "Assessment"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        keywords: ["diagnosis", "assessment", "likely", "impression", "consistent with"]
      - id: "soap_plan"
        path: "Condition.note.text"
        label: "Plan"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        keywords: ["plan", "prescribe", "recommend", "follow-up", "advised"]

  - resourceType: MedicationRequest
    id: section_prescription
    label: "Medication"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "rx_medication"
        path: "MedicationRequest.medicationCodeableConcept"
        label: "Medication"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "rx_dosage"
        path: "MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.text"
        label: "Dosage Instructions"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "rx_status"
        path: "MedicationRequest.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["active","completed","cancelled"]

  - resourceType: Invoice
    id: section_billing
    label: "Billing Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "billing_total"
        path: "Invoice.totalGross.value"
        label: "Total Amount"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "billing_status"
        path: "Invoice.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["draft","issued","balanced","cancelled"]
        required: true
      - id: "billing_payment_method"
        path: "Invoice.paymentTerms"
        label: "Payment Method"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Cash","Card","UPI","Insurance"]
